ns2:course.label: Spatial Analysis
ns2:course.description: Overview of the spatial analysis (nomothetic) approach to geographic research, both physical and human; includes discussion of the scientific method, with explanations and uses of analytic geographic concepts in studying real world problems. Prerequisite: A course in geography.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BALAS: Geography & GIS - UIUC, NONE: Geog&GIS Unassign-UIUC, BSLAS:Comp Sci & Geog&GIS-UIUC, or BSLAS: Geography & GIS - UIUC.
